name: proto
description: Proto on your laptop: set up your account, import your product's design system, build prototypes, and serve them at public URLs, driven by your coding agent.

interface.shortDescription: Prototypes from your product's own code
interface.longDescription: Proto makes prototypes from your product's own codebase. This plugin runs on your laptop and is driven by your coding agent: it connects your account, imports your product's design system, builds prototypes and serves them at public URLs from your active conversation. Website actions provide prompts to copy into your coding agent.
defaultPrompt: Set up Proto for my codebase
